title: Cellulitis, home with home health; plan discussion and provider-choice items appear only as unchecked template boxes

rationale.dp_evaluation: The assessment box is checked and is followed by real content (living situation, prior function, anticipated needs).
rationale.dp_discussed: The only mentions of discussing the plan are unchecked template boxes in the CM note and the nursing education checklist; an unchecked box documents nothing.
rationale.pac_list: 'List of Medicare-certified home health agencies ... provided' is an unchecked box; nothing shows a list was given.
rationale.pac_choice: The freedom-of-choice box is unchecked and 'Agency selected by patient' is blank; a referral to one agency does not show the patient chose it.
rationale.pac_quality_data: The Care Compare quality-data box is unchecked.
rationale.info_transmitted: The summary was sent electronically to the PCP and a home health referral was faxed to the agency.
